rules.statement: A security may be ordered in respect of potential compensation awarded under Section 667 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) Security is ordered against compensation that may be ordered under S. 667 C.P.C. (2) Section. 667 C.P.C. contemplates two situations: (1) When the injunction was applied for on insufficient grounds whatever the result of the case may be; (2) In the court's view there was no probable ground for applying for it where the result of the action is against the party obtaining the injunction.
